recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: autumn dusk over san francisco, mostly clear sky at fourteen degrees
quiet wind across the bay while terminals debate whether llms were inevitable
macos slipping off the official unix family tree without ceremony
personal ai agents booting on free edge servers in someone's pocket
evening shipping windows closing before sunrise on the other coast

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling POSIX command glyphs before a fading Apple logo rewrites them into proprietary symbols — a registry eviction you can feel in your thumb.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left/right between three terminal columns
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Clear one full registry row before the logo completes its silent overwrite.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Glyphs fall faster; rogue logo fragments spawn decoy slots that corrupt your row.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: phosphor-green CRT over foggy autumn dusk

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Deploy micro edge-workers by holding and releasing at the exact moment inference tokens materialize — keep a self-hosted agent alive on a shoestring server budget.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: hold to charge a worker pod, release when the token pulse peaks
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: One successful deployment wave — watch the agent boot and exhale.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Token burst frequency climbs; cold-start windows shrink until only perfect releases survive.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: frosted glass datacenter tiles at golden hour

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw shipping routes from your phone icon to a sunrise horizon — fork paths for parallel agents, but only one route can reach production before dawn.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to sketch routes; tap a fork to kill a redundant agent branch
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: One sunrise delivery — the satisfying snap when the winning path locks in.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: More agent forks spawn mid-draw; wind shear bends existing lines off-course.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor bay fog bleeding into orange dawn

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tap branching probability waves in an LLM inference tree — each beat chooses a fork, proving the next token wasn't inevitable, just one path you steered.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: tap when the active wave crest aligns with your chosen branch
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Resolve one complete inference fork — from prompt to surprising output in under a minute.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Branch density doubles; off-beat taps collapse sibling paths and raise tempo.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon probability ribbons on matte black
